title: Dominated convergence for the bounded continuous multipliers χ(g_j) against an integrable density
statement: For every P ∈ ℕ, every measure ν on ℝ^P, every ν-integrable F : ℝ^P → ℝ, every set K ⊆ ℝ^P with F(x) = 0 for every x ∉ K, every function f : ℝ^P → ℝ, every sequence (g_j)_{j∈ℕ} of measurable functions ℝ^P → ℝ with g_j(x) → f(x) for every x ∈ K, and every continuous χ : ℝ → ℝ with |χ(s)| ≤ 1 for all s: ∫ χ(g_j(x))·F(x) dν(x) → ∫ χ(f(x))·F(x) dν(x) as j → ∞ (Bochner integrals).
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Eucl P)) (F : Eucl P → ℝ) (K : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (g : ℕ → Eucl P → ℝ) (χ : ℝ → ℝ), Integrable F ν → (∀ x, x ∉ K → F x = 0) → (∀ j, Measurable (g j)) → (∀ x ∈ K, Tendsto (fun j => g j x) atTop (𝓝 (f x))) → Continuous χ → (∀ s, |χ s| ≤ 1) → Tendsto (fun j => ∫ x, χ (g j x) * F x ∂ν) atTop (𝓝 (∫ x, χ (f x) * F x ∂ν))
